column.text: Bitcoin is currently trading below eighty thousand dollars after a sharp pullback from recent peaks, even as the broader market cap sits flat to slightly down by three percent. This divergence masks significant institutional strength with thirty-three-seven million dollars flowing into spot BTC ETFs this week alone while retail distribution continues in equities and altcoins. The dominant on-chain signal shows expanding open interest across major assets paired with neutral funding rates, suggesting fresh positioning rather than leverage exhaustion despite the daily RSI for Bitcoin exceeding eighty indicating technical overextension. We are witnessing a clear decoupling from Nasdaq correlation which has dropped to zero point one one confirming that crypto-native rallies in AI and privacy sectors like HYPE and LIT can surge independently of traditional tech weakness. The primary risk remains macro-driven volatility if US yields re-ignite or geopolitical tensions escalate regarding Iran Oman corridors as international oil prices dip temporarily following joint statements establishing temporary maritime routes. Dollar liquidity is contracting which forces demand for more proof on continuation longs while treating failed rallies as better odds shorts until a real catalyst emerges beyond mere euphoria readings at seventy-four fear and greed index levels. Jane Street increasing its SanDisk holdings by fifty-four percent signals institutional rotation into specific thematic plays rather than broad market bets.
